title: 第19章 国强小吃店开业-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一百八十块。

    林国强手里有这个钱。

    上个月挣了两百多，加上分家剩下的，凑一凑能拿出来。

    但他不想把钱全砸在房租上，还得留点周转资金。

    “马主任，我能不能先交三个月？”

    “三个月？”马主任摇了摇头，“不行，最少半年，你要是拿不出来，就算了，后面还有人等着呢。”

    林国强没有再说什么，道了谢就走了。

    但他没有放弃。

    他打听了一下，知道马主任这个人有个毛病……爱贪小便宜。

    他是供销社副主任，手里有点小权，平时没少收人好处。

    而且他老婆身体不好，常年吃药，家里开销大，这间铺面的租金是他重要的收入来源。

    第二天，林国强又去了。

    这次他带了十个肉夹馍和一饭盒卤味，用油纸包好，放在马主任面前。

    “马主任，您尝尝，这是我做的。”

    马主任本来不太想吃，但香味钻进鼻子里，忍不住拿了一个咬了一口。

    嚼了两下，眼睛就亮了。

    “嗯？这味道不错啊！”

    “您要是喜欢，以后我每周给您送点。”

    马主任三两口吃完一个，又拿了第二个，含糊不清地说：“你这手艺确实可以，开个店，生意肯定差不了。”

    “所以还得麻烦马主任通融通融。

    三个月，我先交三个月的，要是生意好，后面续租的时候我把半年的补齐。”

    马主任嚼着肉夹馍，想了想，终于点了头：“行吧，看在你手艺不错的份上，三个月就三个月。

    但说好了，三个月后要么续半年，要么搬走，别跟我扯皮。”

    “一定一定。”

    林国强当场交了九十块钱，签了三个月的租约。

    拿到钥匙的那一刻，他心里踏实了。

    接下来的几天，他忙着收拾店面。

    店面不大，但收拾起来不简单。

    墙面要重新刷，地面要铺水泥，灶台要砌，还得接上下水。

    林国强自己动手，能省就省，但该花钱的地方绝不抠搜。

    他找人焊了一个铁皮灶台，买了两个大号的铁锅。

    又添了几样厨具。

    案板、菜刀、漏勺、大盆、小碗，零零碎碎地买了一堆。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

One hundred and eighty yuan.

Lin Guoqiang has this money.

上个月挣了两百多，加上分家剩下的，凑一凑能拿出来。

But he didn’t want to spend all his money on rent, and he still had to keep some working capital.

"Director Ma, can I pay for three months first?"

"Three months?" Director Ma shook his head, "No, at least half a year. If you can't get it out, forget it. There are still people waiting behind you."

Lin Guoqiang said nothing more, thanked him and left.

But he didn't give up.

He inquired about it and found out that Director Ma had a problem...he loved petty gains.

He is the deputy director of the supply and marketing cooperative. He has a little power in his hands and usually receives benefits from others.

“ Moreover, his wife is in poor health and takes medicine all the year round. The family has a lot of expenses. The rent from this shop is his important source of income.

The next day, Lin Guoqiang went again.

This time he brought ten meat buns and a lunch box of braised meat, wrapped them in oil paper and placed them in front of Director Ma.

"Director Ma, try it, I made it."

Director Ma didn’t really want to eat it at first, but the smell got into his nose and he couldn’t help but take one and take a bite.

After chewing it twice, my eyes lit up.

"Huh? This tastes good!"

"If you like it, I will send you some every week."

Director Ma finished one in two bites, took the second one, and said vaguely: "Your skills are indeed good. If you open a store, the business will definitely be good."

“So I have to ask Director Ma to be accommodating.

Three months, I will pay three months first. If business is good, I will make up half a year when the lease is renewed."

Director Ma chewed the meat buns, thought about it, and finally nodded: "Okay, because of your good craftsmanship, three months will be three months.

But we agreed that after three months we would either renew for half a year or move out, so don’t argue with me."

"Absolutely."

Lin Guoqiang paid 90 yuan on the spot and signed a three-month lease.

The moment he got the key, he felt at ease.

In the next few days, he was busy cleaning up the store.

The store is not big, but it is not easy to clean up.

The walls need to be repainted, the floor needs to be paved with cement, the stove needs to be built, and the water supply needs to be connected.

Lin Guoqiang saves money by doing it himself, but he will never pick out where to spend money.

He found someone to weld an iron stove and bought two large iron pots.

I added a few more kitchen utensils.

Chopping boards, kitchen knives, colanders, large basins, small bowls, I bought a bunch of them here and there.
